big_case.notes: The underlying question (whether 922(g)(1) survives as applied to a nonviolent drug-possession felon after Bruen and Rahimi) is nationally significant with a live circuit split, but this event is a derivative Solicitor General hold-and-GVR request on a single-defendant as-applied ruling, with no request for plenary review; the denial leaves one Fifth Circuit as-applied judgment standing and settles nothing beyond it. Moderate stakes for the event, high for the doctrine behind it. The predictors' big_case_score fields were visible in the staged prediction.json before this read was written; the read rests on the petition, the brief in opposition and the outcome.
